confirmedFindings.title: Local Time Serialization Without UTC Offset Corrupts Billing
confirmedFindings.body: Serializing CDR timestamps via toLocaleString() drops ISO 8601 UTC standard offsets, corrupting billing reconciliation and rating window calculations across multi-region server clusters.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Use date.toISOString() or explicit UTC timestamp representation.
